```python
"""Small text helpers."""

import re

def truncate(text, width):
    """Cut text to `width` characters, ending with '...' when it was shortened."""
    if len(text) <= width:
        return text
    return text[: max(width - 3, 0)] + "..."

def word_count(text):
    """Count the words in a piece of text."""
    return len(text.split())

def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to a slug: lowercase, replace spaces with dashes, and remove punctuation."""
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', text)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '-', text).strip('-')
```

```python
from textutil.text import truncate, word_count, slugify


def test_short_text_is_unchanged():
    assert truncate("hello", 10) == "hello"


def test_long_text_gets_an_ellipsis():
    assert truncate("hello world", 8) == "hello..."


def test_word_count():
    assert word_count("one two  three") == 3
    assert word_count("") == 0


def test_slugify():
    assert slugify("Hello World!") == "hello-world"
    assert slugify("  Leading and trailing spaces  ") == "leading-and-trailing-spaces"
    assert slugify("Punctuation!@#$%^&*()_+") == "punctuation"
    assert slugify("Already-a-slug") == "already-a-slug"
```
